criterion 3.justification: Credit spread (i-spread) on 01-Oct-25: Bond remaining life on 01-Oct-25: (17/09/34 - 01/10/25) / 365.25 = 8.961yrs (target tenor) Corresponding lower EUR MS tenor = 7.000yrs Corresponding upper EUR MS tenor = 10.000yrs Corresponding lower EUR MS rate= 2.406% Corresponding upper EUR MS rate= 2.581% Interpolated EUR MS Rate = Lower rate + (Upper rate - lower rate) / (Upper tenor - lower tenor) * (Target tenor - lower tenor) 2.406% + (2.581% - 2.406%) / (10.000yrs - 7.000yrs) * (8.961yrs - 7.000yrs) = 2.520% Credit spread = YTM - interpolated EUR MS Rate = 4.718% - 2.520% = 219.8bps
